messages:
marta: Canary in eu-west showing ~3% 500s on /v2/embeds since 10:42 UTC. Suggest quick stop and sideload to pinned:v1.9.2 for eu region. Opinions?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout v1.10.0 -> 10% in eu-west started at 10:30 UTC. Current metrics: error_rate=2.9%, p95_latency +120ms. To abort run: `/deploy abort --id 1769743210`

liam: Agree — >2.5% is our canary threshold. Is this infra or model change? Any GPU OOMs?

alex: infra looks clean, no OOMs. I see optimizer CPU spikes on a subset of hosts — could be a kernel selection/path issue in the runtime. Recommend pinning region back to v1.9.2 and draining new instances.

priya: @marta can you run `redwoodctl traffic shift --region eu-west --to pinned:v1.9.2 --percent 100`? If deploy-bot can stage a sideload, we'll flip fast.

marta: Running the shift now. ops oncall @liam please watch logs and traces.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Alert created: embed-500s-eu crossing 2.5% — incident INC-2026-042 opened and linked.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received traffic-shift request for thread 1769743210. Confirm action: react :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to cancel.

liam: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup: initiating 100% shift to pinned:v1.9.2 now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Executing traffic shift... logs:
```
Shifting route: /v2/embeds -> pinned:v1.9.2
Start: 2026-03-21T10:45:05Z
Action: reroute-proxy + update-compute-weights
Status: completed in 18s
Affected zones: eu-west-1 (100% traffic now pinned)
```
Traffic now 100% -> pinned:v1.9.2 in eu-west.

marta: Confirmed: error rate dropped to 0.4% within 2 minutes. Keeping pinned while runtime team digs in (hotfix window).

alex: I'll open a runtime ticket with perf traces, kernel-selection logs, and a heap of sampling traces. Assigning to @runtime-team.

priya: For release notes: "Canary rollback in eu-west: v1.10.0 -> pinned v1.9.2 due to elevated /v2/embeds 500s; follow-up runtime investigation and hotfix planned."

marta: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread updated once runtime triage has root cause. Last check at 10:57 UTC shows stability, will leave the incident open for trace collection.
